visualCharacteristics.purpose: photo gallery: a grid of thumbnails that opens a lightbox viewer with caption, slide counter and prev / next / close / fullscreen buttons

contentPattern.structure: one row per photo: image cell + optional caption cell. The lightbox viewer, caption bar, counter and buttons are runtime UI drawn by the block, not authored

reuseGuidance: Use for any photo set that should open in a lightbox. Do not author the lightbox, caption strip or counter: catalog variants for those were folded into this block.
